segments.text: ESP32 AI squeezes a 28.9 million parameter language model onto an $8 ESP32S3
with no server connection. The trick is keeping a 25 million parameter embedding table in flash and fetching only the rows needed for each token while the
compute heavy core stays in faster memory. The maintainer measures roughly 9.5 tokens per second. It's an architecture experiment, not a chatbot.
